# thoth_mcp_inventory_digest (Data Source)

Reads MCP inventory digest with top unapproved endpoints and remediation actions.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `window_hours` (Number) Digest lookback window in hours. Defaults to 168.

### Read-Only

- `recommended_actions` (List of String) Recommended actions generated by GovAPI.
- `response_json` (String) Digest payload as JSON.
- `top_unapproved_endpoints_json` (String) Top unapproved endpoint rows as JSON array.
- `total_endpoints` (Number) Total endpoints observed in the digest window.
- `unapproved_calls` (Number) Total unapproved MCP calls in the digest window.
- `unapproved_endpoints` (Number) Endpoints with one or more unapproved MCP calls.
